title: Activity catalog
description: The catalog of activities at packages/naive/src/functions/activities.json (EE-164). An activity is a unit of work (APQC level 4) written as an O*NET task statement and filed under an APQC level 2 process group from packages/naive/src/functions/tools.json, optionally under a level 3 process. Its scope is cross-industry or one NAICS industry. It may be scored on the published scales the catalog lists, and a scored activity names who rated it, when and on what basis. Every object allows only the properties listed. packages/naive/src/checks/check-activities.ts checks it across files.

scales.description: The published scales an activity may be scored on. A rating's value must sit inside its scale's range.

id.description: regulatory-restriction, physical-deployment and cognitive-complexity are from the CDR taxonomy; verification from the RL feasibility index; importance, share and frequency from O*NET.

range.description: The lowest and highest value, inclusive.

means.description: What the scale measures, and what its ends mean.

process_group.description: An APQC level 2 process group id in packages/naive/src/functions/tools.json, such as 3.1.

process.description: An APQC level 3 process id under the process group, such as 3.1.2.

statement.description: One sentence in O*NET task statement form: a capitalized verb first, then its object and, where useful, how or why, ending with a period; at most 30 words.

scope.description: Where the activity applies: every industry, or one NAICS industry.

naics.description: A NAICS code, two to six digits.

locator.description: Where in the source, such as a task id or a page.

changed.description: True when the statement was reworded from the source.

ratings.description: Scores on the catalog's scales. A score is one rater's judgment.

rated.description: Who rated the activity, when, and on what. Required with ratings.
